visits.reviewText: The seekh kabab still hits. Sea breeze, fairy lights, and that Do Darya hum — Karachi at its best.
visits.memoryNote: Post-cricket match dinner with the boys.

visits.reviewText: Sunday morning nihari ritual. The paya broth is unreal — worth the Burns Road parking nightmare.
Brunch for Ami's birthday. Eggs benedict solid, service warm, Clifton parking still painful.
New Year's biryani run. Spicy, greasy, perfect. The queue was worth it.
Do Darya date night. Mixed grill platter for two — generous portions, great view.
Afternoon laptop session. Quiet corner, good wifi, pistachio latte on repeat.
Family dinner by the sea. Grilled pomfret was fresh — kids loved the prawn tempura.
Pre-office nihari. Faster service than Waris, almost as good. Naan was still warm.
Solid BBQ but nothing new. Good for groups who can't decide on a place.
Classic Boat Basin run — bun kabab, chai, and people-watching till 1am.
DHA brunch date. Avocado toast actually good — rare for Karachi cafés.
Eid box pickup turned into a feast. Ras malai and gulab jamun — always reliable.
Sabri at dawn hits different. Paya broth is thick, naan arrives hot off the tandoor.
Family dinner at Lal Qila — buffet spread is massive, kids loved the live BBQ counter.
Ginsoy never misses for Chinese in Clifton. Dynamite prawns and chilli dry beef — share everything.
Post-movie burger run. Truffle fries and the classic lab burger — guilty perfection.
Best beef biryani on Burns Road. No debate. Extra raita mandatory.
Birthday cake pickup — red velvet still the move. Staff remembered our order from last year.
Office team dinner at Savour — chicken tikka and naan combo never fails for a crowd.
Saturday morning flat white and a corner seat. Quiet, good wifi, Clifton breeze through the window.
Do Darya sunset dinner. Grilled lobster was worth every rupee — book a sea-facing table.
Sunday family lunch — Mughal biryani portion feeds four easily. Burns Road chaos outside, peace inside.
Post-dinner ice cream at Del Frio. Praline cone on a humid Karachi night — essential.
Clifton date night pasta. Ambience is old-school romantic, portions generous.
Touristy but fun with family — live music, harbour views, and too many food stalls to choose from.
DHA morning chai and paratha. Doodh patti is strong, paratha flaky — perfect pre-work fuel.
New Year's Eve falooda on Burns Road. Sweet, cold, chaotic — peak Karachi.
